Class DocumentObjectTraversingParser

java.lang.Object
tools.jackson.core.JsonParser
tools.jackson.core.base.ParserMinimalBase
org.mongojack.internal.object.document.DocumentObjectTraversingParser
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, tools.jackson.core.Versioned
public class DocumentObjectTraversingParser extends tools.jackson.core.base.ParserMinimalBase
Parses a BSONObject by traversing it. This class was copied from TreeTraversingParser and then adapted to be for BSONObject's, rather than JsonNode's. While decoding by the cursor uses DBDecoderBsonParser, there are still things that need to be decoded from the DBObjects, including the result of findAndModify, and saved objects after saving.
Since:
1.0
Author:
James Roper
